body.name: Multilinear endpoint extension
body.construction: For an endpoint table \(d\), define \(\overline d(X,V)=\mathbb E[d(X,B|_{\mathcal O(X)})\mid V]\), where the revealed coordinates of \(B\) are conditionally independent Bernoulli variables with means equal to the corresponding coordinates of \(V\).
inputs: an estimator table on binary observation cells
